question: Do authenticated EMC specimens exhibit the norepinephrine uptake/vesicular storage transporter combination SLC6A2 with SLC18A1 or SLC18A2 beyond generic neural differentiation, in a way that would justify specific measurement follow-up?
rationale: MIBG uptake/storage requires distinct machinery beyond INSM1/CHRNA6/synaptophysin. Existing SSTR2 expression results are heterogeneous, array-discordant and not a validated broad address; reuse them rather than relabeling as discovery. Transporter co-expression is one useful unanswered contrast; transcript results alone cannot demonstrate uptake, plasma-membrane availability, protein or benefit.

primary_tests.analysis: All authenticated EMC specimen rows and conditions, donor-resolved source-specific descriptive RNA values, gene-wise distributions and rank ordering versus each prespecified histology. No invented positivity or uptake cutoff. Independently measured protein or clinical uptake needed to advance beyond exploratory RNA contrast; absence of RNA assay/probe is not absence of transcript.
primary_tests.selection: No outcome-dependent filtering. Include previously excluded discovery-overlap/lesion rows descriptively with overlap/condition flags; keep independent primary comparisons separate. No pooling sources or unknown donors.

source_gate: Literature search exact/historical EMC names, NR4A3 and noncanonical NR4A2 with SSTR/catecholamine/transporter/MIBG/DOTATATE aliases; source/assay/donor/negative provenance first
Reuse verified public Hofvander2026/GSE24369/GSE4303/GSE28866 identity records; resolve actual source availability/probe coverage before outcomes; no code-based subtype transfers
All newly identified suitable public EMC conditions must be evaluated or kept pending; pending accessible measurements block promotion
advance_conditions: An independently corroborated transporter-specific EMC contrast not already published, not explained equally by generic neural-marker differentiation/nerve admixture/assay cohort confounding, and useful beyond established diagnostic markers. Stronger protein/uptake measurements preferred. Complete relevant public EMC coverage and independent value/validity challenge required.
shelve_conditions: No suitable newly informative measured contrast, unchanged prior result, isolated author-labelled/noncanonical case, unstable donor/assay comparison, or absent protein/uptake validation. Preserve negative/inconclusive and explicitly distinguish accessible pending from unavailable.
restrictions: No browser/computer use06:00-10:00NY; quiet API/files only
No manuscript without actual useful contribution; TMEM266 shelved
Owned path only; no push/root edits; caches preserved
